inputs.name: finale
inputs.initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide, beautiful, legible game environment concept illustration for a Japanese autumn hillside dog Halloween parade called "かぼちゃ灯りの坂道行進". Image purpose: the finale key visual in a planning HTML, NOT a screenshot of an implemented scene.
Input image: provided Unity reference screenshot is environment reference ONLY: modest dry ochre earth, sparse autumn broadleaf trees, rustic wood bench, rolling Japanese hillside and distant mountains. Preserve that humble scale and warm natural character; compose a plausible clearing adjacent to an ascending dirt footpath, not an extravagant park.
Composition: horizontal landscape, eye level from audience at roughly 5 metres, softly painterly stylized 3D game concept art. EXACTLY SIX dogs, all on the ground, standing in a shallow open semicircle, all full bodies clearly visible: one corgi, one Pomeranian, one Labrador retriever, one dachshund, one Shiba Inu, one Samoyed. Keep recognizable normal breed proportions and faces, no anthropomorphic bodies. They wear small pumpkin-orange/cream neck ribbons and tiny leaf accents only; no face masks or large costumes. Leave generous clear space around each face.
Finale effect: a restrained open arc/ring of SIX small softly glowing pumpkin lantern motifs floating ABOVE AND SLIGHTLY BEHIND the dogs, approx 2.5–3.5m above the ground; a few golden leaf trails rising from beside the dogs into these lanterns. Keep the central visual focused on the dogs, not an enormous magic portal. No luminous sphere covering a dog. No fireworks. No dense particles. Orange gold glow with tiny muted plum accents. Friendly and mischievous, not scary.
Lighting: readable warm late-afternoon / early dusk, naturally bright enough to see every dog's face and feet. Keep existing trees sparse, earth modest, distant mountain backdrop readable. No implied full-world night conversion. No stage platform, giant castle, carnival float, crowd, humans or extra dogs, floating dogs, mirrored dogs, text, logo or watermark.
Frame the ascending path entering from lower left into the clearing and a simple bench well off the performance space. This image illustrates artistic intent; ground geometry and furniture placement are conceptual.
inputs.revisionPrompt: Edit this concept image with one targeted environment correction. Preserve exactly the six dogs, their faces, breeds, ribbons, proportions, ground positions and the six pumpkin lanterns and their composition. Replace the stairs and fence at the left with a gently sloping ordinary dirt walking path, no steps, no rails, no staircase, suitable for a small walking cart. Make foreground ground open and modest, with fewer dense decorative leaves and no new objects. Preserve warm readable afternoon mood, bench off to the right, autumn trees and mountain backdrop. This is an outdoor dog parade planning illustration, not a theme park. No text or watermark.

inputs.name: march
inputs.initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A wide landscape illustrated concept for a friendly Japanese autumn hillside Halloween DOG PARADE, showing the MIDDLE WALKING SCENE, for an internal planning document.
Exactly SIX recognizable adult dogs walking naturally on all fours in ONE gently curved single-file procession UP a modest broad compacted-earth slope: leading corgi, followed by Pomeranian, dachshund, Shiba Inu, Labrador retriever, Samoyed at rear. All six distinct and visible, no duplicates. Small pumpkin-orange/cream neck ribbons and leaf decorations only, uncovered faces, normal canine bodies, relaxed walking not galloping. The leader looks slightly back inviting the viewer onward. Approx 1.8 metres between dog centres suggested by clear gaps; generous panorama and believable ground scale.
Audience eye level looking diagonally across the path from its inside/uphill shoulder. The route curves from lower left toward an open clearing in upper right. Dogs travel uphill along one side, leaving much of the central path open. Sparse ochre grass, a few muted orange and olive broadleaf trees, distant Japanese mountains. Humble outdoor game environment, no theme-park extravagance.
A small floating friendly pumpkin guide light ahead of the corgi, a few disconnected tiny amber paw lights briefly following each dog close to the dirt, a few leaf particles ahead. Only one pumpkin guide light, no overhead finale ring in this scene. No enormous sweeping magic ribbon, no glowing dog faces. Bright readable late-afternoon, warm but not intensely orange, same friendly spirit as the finale illustration. Stylized polished game concept painting.
No existing illustration or external artwork is input: design from these general requirements. Do NOT draw crowds, people, extra animals, floats, stairs, paved sidewalks, railings, arches, buildings, stage platforms, text, logos, border or watermark. Terrain is a conceptual illustration, not an exact survey.

review: 6犬種・6匹、犬の顔・足元、低い装飾、灯りの配置を目視確認。初稿の階段・柵/湖は修正。景観・犬モデル・寸法・犬の並びは実シーンの再現ではない。公式条件/契約プランと元環境素材のAI入力条件は本記録では未検証。公開素材やUnity用素材に転用する際は確認する。
